name: paseo-cto
description: A fast CTO loop for Claude Code and Codex: dispatch plan tasks to isolated Paseo agents, accept by risk, land each accepted branch with one command that merges, checks, marks the board, pushes and watches the rollout, and report one status line. Models and effort remain owner decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Run a fast Paseo engineering team
interface.longDescription: Operate the same CTO in Codex or Claude: dispatch plan tasks to isolated Paseo agents, accept routine work by reading and critical work through one independent review, land each accepted branch with one command, watch the rollout, and report one line.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to continue the plan: reconcile the agents, accept and land finished work, dispatch the next tasks.
